summary: Rulings P1–P5 are applied (AnsibleSpecs a6e846f), which resolves blocking finding B1 through Ruling P2. The test phase's ordered sequence now pauses AaC/Architecture and builds it once by hand, pushes on the operator's OK and accepts the KubeCoder dev roll. P3 keeps IoTSupport's secret in its Job without Groovy interpolation, and the guide gains SEC-1's one exception. V01, V04, V18 and V22 read as the rulings say, P11 checks its precondition against the slice's local commits, and the consumer phases fix the docs that name what P11 removes, Architecture's producer manual included (ARCH-17, close-out A1; new V26). The dry run parses all 11 phases.
